exams.name: USMLE (United States Medical Licensing Examination)
exams.notes: All three parts required; conditions and requirements for completion established by board rule. Alternatives include national boards, FLEX, board-approved state-constructed examination, licentiate of the Medical Council of Canada examination, or COMLEX.
exams.quote: Has successfully completed all three (3) parts of the USMLE, national boards, the FLEX, a board approved, state constructed licensing examination, the examination by the licentiate of the medical council of Canada or the COMLEX

exams.name: COMLEX (Comprehensive Osteopathic Medical Licensing Examination)
exams.notes: Alternative to USMLE for osteopathic applicants.
exams.quote: Has successfully completed all three (3) parts of the USMLE, national boards, the FLEX, a board approved, state constructed licensing examination, the examination by the licentiate of the medical council of Canada or the COMLEX

interval_years.quote: All licenses other than temporary licenses and medical training licenses shall lapse annually on a date or dates to be established by rules adopted by the board. A licensee may renew his license each year

required.quote: A licensee may renew his license each year by submitting a renewal application containing information required by the board, accompanied by proof of compliance with and fulfillment of continuing medical education requirements of the board

value: 1 hour of continuing education related to the responsible prescribing of controlled substances or the treatment of substance abuse disorders every two years (for licensees registered to dispense controlled substances)
topical_requirements.quote: The board shall require licensees who are registered with the board of pharmacy to dispense a controlled substance in this state to complete one (1) hour of continuing education related to the responsible prescribing of controlled substances or the treatment of substance abuse disorders every two (2) years.

requirements.value: Wyoming is a member of the Interstate Medical Licensure Compact, providing an expedited licensure pathway for eligible physicians. Physicians may also obtain licensure through standard application meeting all requirements of W.S. 33-26-303. Out-of-state physicians brought into Wyoming for consultation are exempt from licensure requirements, provided the Wyoming-licensed physician notifies the board.
requirements.quote: The Interstate Medical Licensure Compact is enacted into law and entered into on behalf of this state with all other states legally joining in the compact

exists.quote: The Wyoming state board of medicine shall consist of five (5) physicians licensed to practice medicine in Wyoming, not less than one (1) of whom shall possess the degree of doctor of osteopathy and not less than two (2) of whom shall possess the degree of doctor of medicine, one (1) physician assistant and two (2) lay members

definition_quote.value: "Practicing medicine" means any person who in any manner: (A) Advertises, holds out, or represents to the public that he is authorized to practice medicine in this state; or (B) Offers or undertakes to prevent, diagnose, correct or treat, in any manner, by any means, method or device, any human disease, illness, pain, wound, fracture, infirmity, defect or abnormal physical or mental condition, injury, deformity or ailment, including the management of pregnancy and parturition; or (C) Attaches the title of M.D., D.O., P.A., physician, surgeon, osteopathic physician or osteopathic surgeon, doctor, physician assistant or any other words, letters or abbreviations...; or (D) Practices osteopathy; or (E) Offers or undertakes to prescribe, order, give or administer drugs which can only be obtained by prescription according to law; or (F) Renders a determination of medical necessity or appropriateness of proposed treatment.
definition_quote.quote: "Practicing medicine" means any person who in any manner: (A) Advertises, holds out, or represents to the public that he is authorized to practice medicine in this state; or (B) Offers or undertakes to prevent, diagnose, correct or treat, in any manner, by any means, method or device, any human disease, illness, pain, wound, fracture, infirmity, defect or abnormal physical or mental condition, injury, deformity or ailment, including the management of pregnancy and parturition

license_status_types.quote: the board may grant: (i) A license to practice medicine, subject to annual renewal; (ii) A temporary license to practice medicine pursuant to W.S. 33-26-304(a); (iii) A restricted or conditional license; (iv) An inactive license; (v) A medical training license pursuant to W.S. 33-26-304(c); (vi) An emeritus license; (vii) A volunteer license; (viii) An administrative medicine license

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Foreign medical graduates must have been certified by the E.C.F.M.G. (Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates) in lieu of graduating from an L.C.M.E.-accredited U.S. or A.O.A.-accredited osteopathic or Canadian accredited school of medicine.

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: Prescribing any controlled substance via the Internet, World Wide Web, or similar electronic system to a person absent a documented physician-patient relationship is a disciplinary ground.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: Initially prescribing any controlled substance specified in W.S. 35-7-1016 through 35-7-1022 for any person through the Internet, the World Wide Web or a similar proprietary or common carrier electronic system absent a documented physician-patient relationship

telemedicine_license_available.quote: "Telemedicine" means the practice of medicine by electronic communication or other means from a physician in a location to a patient in another location, with or without an intervening health care provider.

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: The Interstate Medical Licensure Compact is enacted into law and entered into on behalf of this state with all other states legally joining in the compact

physician_assistant_supervision_model.quote: A physician assistant may collaborate with or refer to the appropriate member of a healthcare team as indicated by the condition of the patient and the education, experience and competence of the physician assistant and current standard of care. The degree of collaboration shall be determined at the practice level, which may include decisions made by the employer, group, hospital service or the credentialing and privileging systems.

physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.value: A physician assistant may prescribe schedule II, III, IV, or V drugs but not schedule I drugs. A physician assistant may dispense prepackaged medications in rural clinics when pharmacy services are not physically available.
physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.quote: A physician assistant shall not prescribe schedule I drugs as defined by W.S. 35-7-1013 through 35-7-1014. A physician assistant may prescribe schedule II, III, IV or V drugs as defined by W.S. 35-7-1015 through 35-7-1022.

malpractice_reporting_required.quote: Each licensee shall report to the board any personal injury or wrongful death claim made because of any alleged act, error or omission of the licensee. Failure to report the claim shall be grounds for disciplinary action by the board.

hospital_privilege_action_reporting_requ.quote: Each health care entity shall report: (i) Any action it takes against a licensee on the grounds that the licensee is impaired, or has engaged in conduct constituting a ground for disciplinary action in W.S. 33-26-402; (ii) Any action that: (A) Adversely affects the clinical privileges of a licensee for a period exceeding thirty (30) days

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: Participate in and contract with a program or programs to assist in the return to practice of licensees who have exhibited disruptive behaviors, substance dependence or abuse or are suffering from physical or mental impairment

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: The board may order a licensee to undergo one (1) or more mental, physical or medical competency examinations by examiners deemed appropriate by the board if it has reasonable cause to believe that the licensee may be impaired.

administrative_medicine_license_availabl.quote: An administrative medicine license for physicians not providing patient care, provided the qualifications for and the conditions of this license shall be established by rule.
